title: LLMS-Explorer
summary: A research hub for agents: installable skills, context files and per-concept facts files to load whole (listed in /context.md), the concept tree behind them, plus the llms.txt reference and rubric, a directory of every known llms file with its conformance grade, and a recorded keyword/vector/hybrid run.
note: Companion files: llms-full.txt (every page in full), llms-small.txt (the reference, essays and examples layers within ~50k tokens), llms-facts.txt (source-anchored units), llms-vocabulary.txt (the terms of this niche). To load context rather than read pages: /context.md lists every context file and every concept's facts file with absolute URLs, filed by concept-tree root — one fetch to choose, one more to load; /skills/llms.txt lists every installable skill.
